Engine source and licences

The wizard uses the tg C timing engine through the WebAssembly port from MAC Bespoke Web Timegrapher. Its algorithm and compiled assets are unchanged.

tg: copyright 2015–2016 Marcello Mamino, with subsequent maintenance by Alejandro Grigera. WebAssembly port: copyright 2026 MAC Bespoke Watch Co. GNU GPL version 2. Upstream notice.

Vendored revision: c0f93752332804b30064b91db557471162ca65b9. Download the corresponding project source, including its core, build scripts and dependency source instructions. The core uses FFTW, obtained by the upstream build script from fftw.org.

The optional input-band filter comes from jrigol/timegrapher, revision a3021900b49eb1ec30e9497be4f0a0509b3c9d62. Copyright 2026 jrigol. MIT licence. Its tracker and amplitude detector are not used.

The local wrapper performs anti-aliased downsampling, sample-clock correction, separate-window comparison, clipping checks and lift-angle confirmation. The wizard and wrapper are supplied under GNU GPL version 2.
